applies_to: Price UMCB controllers for underfloor air distribution terminals.
summary: UMCB is Price's modulating controller for underfloor air terminals (fan and damper with reheat options) on BACnet MS/TP. The points list has 41 objects: room and probe temperatures, 0-10 V heat/cool inputs, setpoints and limits, damper positions, PI load, fan and reheat type settings and BMS override values for setpoint, room temperature, occupancy and lights.
notes: Instances named N/A in the list (unused: AI 2) are left out.
Several AV objects carry coded values; the codes are listed in the states field.
The list also marks which values are retained after a power failure.

points.name: Damper Cool Max Position
points.description: Lower flow limit (see UMCB flow response chart)

points.name: Damper Heat Min Positon
points.description: Upper flow limit (see UMCB flow response chart)

points.name: Damper Heat Max Position
points.description: Lower flow limit (see UMCB flow response chart)

points.name: Remote Mode Flag
points.description: Remote Mode - Damper Override
points.states: 0=Automatic control (normal run mode), 1=Target Cool Min, 2=Target Cool Max, 3=Target Heat Min, 4=Target Heat Max, 5=Target Neutral Damper Position, 6=Open Damper 100%, 7=Close Damper (0%)

points.name: Fan Type
points.states: 0=No Fan, 1=Fan ON when heat needed, 2=Fan ON when occupied (also ON for Night Heat), 3=Fan always ON, 4=Fan ON when occupid (also ON for Night Heat and Cool), 5=Fan ON during Heat and Cool

points.name: Reheat Type
points.description: Binary reheat configuration
points.states: 0=3 Stages Of Heat, 1=Hot Water (open/close) + 1 Stage Binary, 2=2 Stage Binary + 10sec PWM on Stage 3, 3=Hot Water (open/close) + PWM, 4=3 Stages of Heat (disabled with HOT supply air), 5=Hot Water (open/close) + 1 Stage Binary (disabled with HOT supply air), 6=2 Stage Binary + 10sec PWM on Stage 3 (disabled with HOT supply air), 7=Hot Water (open/close) + PWM (disabled with HOT supply air), 8=Disabled

points.name: Net Setpoint
points.description: Setpoint override from the network (0 = normal operation)

points.name: Net Lights

integration.summary: Use AV 30 Net Occupancy, AV 28 Net Setpoint and, if needed, AV 29 to drive the controller from the BMS; read AV 2 Occupancy, AI 1 room temperature, AV 14 room load and AV 18 damper position.
integration.enable: AV 30 Net Occupancy: 0 = normal operation, 1 = force occupied, 2 = force unoccupied. AV 1 selects thermostat/network control or the 0-10 V heat/cool input signals.
integration.remote_sensors: AV 28 Net Setpoint and AV 29 Net Room Temp override the thermostat setpoint and room temperature from the BMS (0 = normal operation, no override); AV 30 Net Occupancy forces occupied (1) or unoccupied (2).
setup: BACnet MS/TP; Price default baud rate is 76800.
